title: Vitess: per-node Vault PKI cert rotation
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate vitess`: re-issues a fresh leaf from pki_int/issue/vitess-server on every node via its own Vault Agent token, splits the bundle, and restarts the serving unit. Order etcd -> tablet-replicas -> tablet-primaries -> vtgate -> control; tablet restarts are vttablet-only (mysqld stays up, no reparent).

observe.what: 12 rows old->new serial, 0 errors; cluster stays green (rolling, non-disruptive)
JSON CertRotationResult: 12 rotatedNodes, each with a new serial_number, error=null

whatProves: VitessAdapter.RotateCertAsync re-issues per-host certs via the node Agent token + nexus-vitess-tls-split.sh, restarting only the gRPC-serving unit per role so the cluster never loses a primary.
